flows.title: Start a new form
steps: Go to Microsoft Forms and sign in with a Microsoft 365 work or school account, or a Microsoft account.
Give the form a title, and a description if you want one. A title holds up to 90 characters and a description up to 1,000.
The form is saved automatically while you build it.

flows.title: Add questions to a form
steps: Select Add new to put a question on the form.
Choose the kind of question: Choice, Text, Rating or Date.
For Ranking, Likert, File upload or Net Promoter Score, select More question types.
To group questions together, select Section.
stops: deleting a question, which permanently removes the response data collected for it

flows.title: Preview a form before sending it
steps: On a computer, select Preview to see how the form will look.
To test it, answer the questions in Preview mode and select Submit.
To carry on editing, select Back.
